scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build:api && npm run build:admin && npm run build:web
scripts.build:admin: wrangler pages functions build apps/admin/functions --project-directory apps/admin --outdir .wrangler/build/admin
scripts.build:web: wrangler pages functions build apps/web/functions --project-directory apps/web --outdir .wrangler/build/web
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply qraft-production --local --config workers/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply qraft-production --remote --config workers/api/wrangler.toml
